SlotDisplay codec still uses 26.3 numbering (carried from 1.21.8 via the chain); the eight SlotDisplay entries are identical in 1.20.6 and 1.21.1, same order. jsr305 (javax.annotation.Nullable) is committed at tools/jsr305-3.0.2.jar and on the javac classpaths.
